name: Holy Inspiration (Prayer)
body:
The gods of nobility give you the words to inspire your allies.

Prerequisites: Worshiping a deity with the Nobility Domain

Benefit: You can speak an inspiring word your allies within 30 feet. Those allies receive a +2 divine bonus on attack rolls, skill checks, ability checks, and saving throws for a single round.

You can use this ability once per day.
